description: Task execution rules — enforced by AI agent, not CI

rules.name: requirements-doc-required
rules.description: For new features and feature optimizations, AI MUST create a requirements document in harness/requirements/ before any code is written.
steps: 1. Read AGENTS.md + relevant Skills
2. Run harness affected --base origin/main
3. Check both backend/app/ AND backend/pallastrade_gems/ for existing capabilities
4. Fill out harness/requirements/_TEMPLATE.md
5. Save as harness/requirements/REQ-{YYYYMMDD}-{slug}.md
6. Present to user and WAIT for confirmation
7. Only proceed to implementation after user confirms
rules.violation: Skipping requirements doc for new feature/optimization tasks.

rules.name: design-doc-required
rules.description: After requirements confirmation, AI MUST output a design document with decision tree analysis, file change list, and anti-pattern checklist.
steps: 1. Follow customization decision tree
2. List all files to create/modify
3. List Skill + Eval + Test triplet
4. List must-not-do items
5. Present to user for Go/No-Go decision
rules.violation: Skipping design document for new feature/optimization tasks.

rules.name: search-before-create-gate
rules.description: Admin view changes go directly into Gem source files, not Host App overrides (except net-new modules).
steps: 1. Find the target view in backend/pallastrade_gems/pallastrade_admin/app/views/
2. Edit it directly in place (no copying to backend/app/views/)
3. Add `# PALLAS-CUSTOM: <brief reason>` as the first line of the modified file
4. git diff shows exactly what you changed vs the original
rules.exception: Brand-new modules with NO Gem counterpart (e.g., ai/) go in backend/app/views/. These are the only views allowed in Host App.
rules.violation: Copying a Gem view file to Host App for modification instead of editing it in place.

rules.name: view-modification-protocol
rules.description: PallasTrade MVC is distributed across THREE gem layers. Finding something in one layer does NOT mean the other layers are empty. AI MUST search ALL layers independently before concluding.

layer_core.when: When the task involves: models, services, business logic, state machines, associations.

layer_api.when: When the task involves: API endpoints, serializers, request/response formats.

layer_admin.when: When the task involves: Admin UI, admin controllers, admin views, navigation, Stimulus controllers.
layer_admin.note: Stimulus controllers MUST be in the ENGINE's JS path (pallastrade_admin/app/javascript/), NOT in backend/app/javascript/.

layer_storefront.when: When the task involves: Storefront UI, pages, components.

layer_platform.when: When the task involves: TypeScript SDK, React Dashboard, design system.

antiPatterns.description: Finding a model in core gem does NOT mean admin controller is absent. After finding model, MUST ALSO check admin gem for corresponding controller.
antiPatterns.example: Found Category < Taxon in core gem → stopped searching. Missed TaxonsController in admin gem.

antiPatterns.description: Controller names may NOT match model names. Category model ↔ TaxonsController. Search for domain concepts (taxon, categor), not just class names.
antiPatterns.example: Grepped for 'categories_controller' → found nothing. But 'taxons_controller' exists and manages Categories.

antiPatterns.description: Do NOT assume that finding capability in one layer means all layers are covered. Each layer (core/api/admin/storefront) must be independently verified.
antiPatterns.example: Found taxon.rb model → assumed 'no admin exists' → created duplicate.

antiPatterns.description: Admin Stimulus controllers must live in pallastrade_admin/app/javascript/pallastrade/admin/controllers/, NOT in backend/app/javascript/controllers/. The admin gem uses importmap with explicit imports from its own JS path.
antiPatterns.example: Created category_cascade_controller.js in backend/app/javascript/controllers/ → not loaded by importmap. Correct path: pallastrade_admin/app/javascript/pallastrade/admin/controllers/.

rules.violation: Skipping cross-layer search before concluding capability is absent.

rules.name: search-before-create-gate
rules.description: Before creating ANY new file, AI MUST search for existing files with similar names or domain concepts. If a similar file exists in framework layers, analyze whether it can be extended via Decorator/DI rather than duplicated.
steps: 1. Identify the domain concept (e.g., 'category management')
2. Search ALL gem directories for files containing the concept name OR its synonyms
3. List files found with full paths
4. For each found file, answer: 'Does this already satisfy the requirement?'
5. If yes → report. If partial → extend via Decorator/DI. If no → then create.

rules.name: verification-evidence-required
rules.description: Before clearing verify-test, AI MUST provide objective evidence. UI changes: screenshot/DOM snapshot. Backend changes: log line or DB result. Config changes: restart confirmation. No-test-needed only for pure docs/comments.

evidenceTable.UI: Screenshot or DOM snapshot showing corrected state
evidenceTable.Backend: Rails log line showing Completed 200 OK / 302 Found
evidenceTable.Config: Server restart + log confirming new config loaded

rules.violation: Clearing verify-test without providing matching evidence for the change type. 'No test needed' is NOT valid for UI or backend logic changes.
